units.source_text: ”他在幽暗的灯光之下把她堆垂在额前的头发撩起一看，

en.t: Under the dim lamplight, he lifted the hair that hung heavily over her forehead and looked at her,

units.source_text: 但见她的容貌艳丽之极，简直是十全其美。

en.t: and saw that her beauty was dazzling beyond measure, almost perfectly flawless.

units.source_text: 他想：“在如此荒寂的住处，好色之徒可以毫无阻碍地任所欲为。

en.t: He thought, "In such a desolate dwelling, a lustful man could do whatever he wished without the slightest hindrance.

units.source_text: 如果来访的人不是我而是别的男子，

en.t: If the visitor had been another man instead of me,

units.source_text: 我一定会被挤出局外，那样的话，该多么遗憾啊！”

en.t: I would surely have been pushed aside, and how bitterly I would have regretted it!"

units.source_text: 回思过去自己优柔寡断，竟担心起来。

en.t: Thinking back on how indecisive he had been, he grew anxious.

units.source_text: 然而看到她毫无办法地伤心饮泣的模样，又实在可怜，

en.t: Yet when he saw her weeping helplessly in sorrow, he could not help pitying her,

units.source_text: 他想：“现在切不可强求，将来她自有心情柔顺的时候。”

en.t: and thought, "I must not force her now; in time her heart will naturally soften."

units.source_text: 他觉得使她惊惶失措，实在对她不起，

en.t: He felt truly sorry for having frightened her into such confusion,

units.source_text: 便规规矩矩地用好言抚慰她。

en.t: and so he comforted her properly with gentle words.

units.source_text: 但大女公子恨恨地对他说道：“我料不到你会起这念头，

en.t: But the elder princess said to him resentfully, "I never imagined you would harbor such intentions,

units.source_text: 所以过去异乎寻常地亲近你。

en.t: and that is why I was unusually close to you before.

units.source_text: 我穿着可哀的丧服，而你毫无顾忌地闯进来看，

en.t: Here I am in these pitiful mourning robes, and you burst in without the slightest restraint to look at me;

units.source_text: 此心太浅薄了。

en.t: your heart is far too shallow.

units.source_text: 明知我们懦弱无能，所以任情欺负。

en.t: Knowing full well that we are weak and powerless, you bully us as you please.

units.source_text: 我这悲哀实在无法自慰。”

en.t: This grief of mine truly cannot be consoled."

units.source_text: 她不曾提防，被薰君在灯光之下看到了憔悴的丧服姿态，非常困窘懊恼。

en.t: She had not been on guard, and after Lord Kaoru saw her wan and wasted figure in mourning dress beneath the lamplight, she was deeply embarrassed and distressed.

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“你对我如此深恶痛疾，

en.t: Lord Kaoru answered, "Since you loathe me so intensely,

units.source_text: 使我羞耻得话也说不出口了。

en.t: I am so ashamed that I cannot even bring myself to speak.

units.source_text: 你以身穿丧服为借口，固然是可以的。

en.t: Of course, it is understandable that you use your mourning clothes as a reason.
